name: Poster POS
description: Poster POS (joinposter.com), the cloud point of sale for cafes, restaurants and shops: menu products and categories, orders with their lines, sales reports by product, category, waiter, customer and location, payments per day, customers and loyalty groups, stock levels, supplies, write-offs, suppliers, employees and register shifts. Account token.
prerequisites: A Poster POS account and its personal integration token from the management console (Access, Integrations). Any account owner can create one; no developer account or app review is needed. About 3 minutes.

POSTER_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Account token
POSTER_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: Poster management console, Access, Integrations: the personal integration token. Paste it whole: the account number, a colon and the 32 characters after it.
POSTER_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: The token is the account number, a colon and the token itself, e.g. 687409:4164553abf6a031302898da7800b59fb, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: Poster refused the token (error 10, 11 or 12: missing, wrong or expired). Copy the personal integration token again from Access, Integrations in the management console, with the account number and the colon in front.
verifyHints.403: Poster refused the call: the token has no access to this method (error 20 or 54), or the account is archived because its subscription ended. Use the owner token, or reactivate the account.
verifyHints.404: Poster found no record with this id (error 32). Take ids from the list tools.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Poster is limiting the request rate (error 700). Wait a few seconds and call again; ask for narrower date ranges instead of many calls.

instructions:
## Poster POS
This connector works with the **Poster Web API** (`https://joinposter.com/api`) of Poster POS, the cloud point of sale for cafes, restaurants and shops: menu, orders, sales reports, customers and loyalty groups, stock, suppliers, employees, locations and register shifts. Every call is `https://joinposter.com/api/` followed by the method name, with the account token in the `token` query parameter; the connector adds the token itself.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign in to the Poster management console of your account as the owner.
2. Open **Access**, then **Integrations**, and create or copy the **personal integration token**. It looks like `687409:4164553abf6a031302898da7800b59fb`: the account number, a colon and 32 characters.
3. Paste the whole value, account number included, into `POSTER_ACCESS_TOKEN` and install the connector. The token has full access to the account, so keep it private.

A token from an app of the Poster developer account (OAuth, `access_token` of the authorization) has the same format and works too, limited to what the app was granted.

**Where to start**: `poster_pos_get_settings` (currency and time zone of the account), then `poster_pos_list_spots` for the locations, `poster_pos_list_registers` for the tablets and `poster_pos_list_employees` for waiter ids.

**Menu**: `poster_pos_list_categories`, `poster_pos_list_products` (price per location under `spots`), `poster_pos_get_product` (recipe and modifiers) and `poster_pos_list_ingredients`.

**Orders**: `poster_pos_list_transactions` lists receipts of a date range, optionally for one waiter, location or customer; `poster_pos_get_transaction` and `poster_pos_list_transaction_products` read one order with its lines. `poster_pos_list_orders` exports closed orders with products page by page.

**Reports**: `poster_pos_get_sales_analytics` (revenue, profit, checks, guests and average check over time), `poster_pos_get_product_sales`, `poster_pos_get_category_sales`, `poster_pos_get_waiter_sales`, `poster_pos_get_client_sales`, `poster_pos_get_spot_sales`, `poster_pos_get_payments_report` (cash, card, points and certificates per day) and `poster_pos_list_cash_shifts`.

**Customers**: `poster_pos_list_clients` (search by `phone`), `poster_pos_get_client`, `poster_pos_list_client_groups`, `poster_pos_create_client` and `poster_pos_update_client`. `poster_pos_remove_client` is installed switched off. The connector never changes loyalty points, e-wallets or purchase totals.

**Stock**: `poster_pos_list_storages`, `poster_pos_list_stock_leftovers` (current stock and low stock thresholds), `poster_pos_get_stock_movement_report`, `poster_pos_list_supplies` with `poster_pos_list_supply_ingredients`, `poster_pos_list_wastes`, `poster_pos_list_stock_transfers`, `poster_pos_list_suppliers` and `poster_pos_create_supplier`.

**Field notes**
- Money: most amounts are integers in minor units (kopecks, cents): `60000` is 600.00 in the account currency. The counters of `poster_pos_get_sales_analytics` are in the main unit. Each tool says which applies.
- Dates: the date filters of most tools are `YYYYMMDD` without separators (`20261130`); `poster_pos_list_orders` takes `YYYY-MM-DD`. Without dates Poster returns the last month. Order times in `poster_pos_list_transactions` are Unix timestamps in milliseconds; add `timezone` `client` for the account time zone.
- Numbers arrive as strings in many answers (`"product_id": "139"`). Flags are `0` and `1`; `delete` `1` marks a removed record.
- Most lists are not paged and return everything at once. Narrow them with dates, a location or a category before asking for products or customers of a large account.
- Errors come inside a normal answer as `error` with a `code` and a `message`: 10 to 12 a missing, wrong or expired token, 20 or 54 no access, 32 an id that does not exist, 34 a missing required property, 38 a name that already exists, 700 the rate limit. Wait a few seconds after error 700.
- Not included: opening, changing or closing orders on the register, payments, online orders, finance transactions, and anything that removes menu or stock records.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_settings
tools.description: Check the token and read the account settings: COMPANY_ID (account name), company_name, company_type (1 cafe, 2 store), timezones (the account time zone), lang, currency (name, symbol and ISO code), tip_amount and which modules are on (uses_tables, uses_cash_shifts, uses_taxes, uses_multiprice, uses_manufacturing, uses_fiscality). Call it first to learn the currency and time zone. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_spots
tools.description: List the locations (venues) of the account: spot_id, spot_name, spot_adress and the storages attached to each (storage_id, storage_name). Spot ids filter the sales reports and prices. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_registers
tools.description: List the POS registers (tablets): tablet_id, tablet_name and the spot_id each one belongs to. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_employees
tools.description: List the employees: user_id, name, role_id, role_name, user_type (0 waiter, 1 administrator, 2 marketer, 3 storekeeper, 4 floor administrator, 50 manager, 90 owner), access_mask and last_in (last login to the management console). user_id is the waiter id in transactions and reports. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_categories
tools.description: List the menu categories: category_id, category_name, parent_category, level, category_hidden, sort_order, fiscal, nodiscount, tax_id and category_tag. Read-only.

fiscal.description: 1 for fiscal categories only, 0 for non-fiscal only. Default: all.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_products
tools.description: List the products and dishes of the menu: product_id, product_name, type (1 semi-finished, 2 dish, 3 product), menu_category_id, category_name, barcode, product_code (SKU), unit, cost, workshop, weight_flag, tax_id, modifications, and spots with the price, profit and visibility per location. cost, price and profit are in minor units (kopecks, cents): divide by 100. All rows come in one answer. Read-only.

category_id.description: Only products of this category (category_id of poster_pos_list_categories).

type.description: products for goods sold as bought, batchtickets for dishes with a recipe. Default: both.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_product
tools.description: Read one product or dish: the fields of poster_pos_list_products plus cooking_time, product_production_description, the ingredients of a dish (ingredient_id, name, quantity and unit per recipe line) and group_modifications (modifier sets with their options and prices). Amounts are in minor units. Read-only.

product_id.description: Product or dish id from poster_pos_list_products.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_ingredients
tools.description: List the ingredients: ingredient_id, ingredient_name, category_id, ingredient_left (total stock over all storages), limit_value (low stock threshold), ingredient_unit (kg, p for pieces, l), ingredient_weight and the loss percentages for cleaning and cooking. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_transactions
tools.description: List the orders (receipts) of a date range: transaction_id, date_start and date_close (Unix time in milliseconds, date_close 0 while open; date_close_date is the same as Y-m-d H:i:s), status (1 open, 2 closed, 3 removed), pay_type (0 closed without payment, 1 cash, 2 card, 3 mixed), sum, payed_sum, payed_cash, payed_card, payed_bonus, payed_third_party, round_sum, discount (percent), guests_count, spot_id, table_id, table_name, user_id (waiter), client_id, transaction_comment and total_profit; with include_products the lines too. Amounts are in minor units (divide by 100). For more rows pass the last transaction_id as next_tr. Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

type.description: Filter by a waiter, a location or a customer; always together with id.

id.description: Id of the waiter (user_id), location (spot_id) or customer (client_id) named by type.

include_products.description: true to add the product lines (product_id, modification_id, num, product_price, payed_sum, product_cost, product_profit).

include_history.description: true to add the change history of each order.

next_tr.description: Continue after this transaction_id (the last one of the previous answer).

after_date_close.description: Only orders closed after this Unix timestamp. Poster does not document the unit; date_close in its answers is in milliseconds.

before_date_close.description: Only orders closed before this Unix timestamp (same unit as after_date_close).

timezone.description: client to return dates in the account time zone.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_transaction
tools.description: Read one order by its number: the fields of poster_pos_list_transactions plus tip_sum, tips_card and tips_cash, and with include_products its product lines. The answer is a list with one element. Amounts are in minor units. Read-only.

include_products.description: true to add the product lines.

include_history.description: true to add the change history (opened, products added, payments, closed).

timezone.description: client to return dates in the account time zone.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_transaction_products
tools.description: List the products of one order with names: product_id, product_name, modification_id, modificator_name, num (quantity), product_sum, payed_sum, discount, bonus_sum, round_sum, cert_sum, product_cost, product_profit, tax_value, tax_type, category_id, workshop, barcode and product_code. Amounts are in minor units. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_orders
tools.description: List closed orders with their products for a date range, a page at a time: count, page (per_page, page, count) and data rows with transaction_id, spot_id, table_id, client_id, sum, payed_sum, payed_cash, payed_card, payed_cert, payed_bonus, payed_third_party, pay_type, tip_sum, discount, date_close (Y-m-d H:i:s) and products (product_id, modification_id, num, product_sum, payed_sum, discount, workshop_id). Use it to export many orders with lines; raise page until count is reached. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_sales_analytics
tools.description: Sales report over time. Without type: data (one value per day, week or month for the chosen metric), data_hourly, data_weekday and counters with revenue, profit, transactions, visitors, average_receipt and average_time (minutes) for the whole period, in the main currency unit. With type waiters or clients the answer is one row per waiter or customer instead. Default period: the 30 days before date_to. Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD, e.g. 20261101. Default: 30 days before date_to.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

interpolate.description: Step of the data series (default day).

select.description: Metric of the data series (default revenue).

type.description: Break down or filter by waiter, station, category, product, location or customer. Default: the whole account.

id.description: Id of one waiter, station, category, product, location or customer of the chosen type.

business_day.description: true to count by business day (the venue closing time) instead of calendar day.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_product_sales
tools.description: Sales per product for a date range: product_id, product_name, modification_id, modification_name, category_id, count (quantity sold), weight_flag, product_sum, payed_sum, product_profit and discount. Amounts are in minor units (divide by 100). Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

spot_id.description: Location id from poster_pos_list_spots. Default: all locations.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_category_sales
tools.description: Sales per menu category for a date range: category_id, category_name, count, revenue and profit. Amounts are in minor units (divide by 100). Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

spot_id.description: Location id from poster_pos_list_spots. Default: all locations.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_waiter_sales
tools.description: Sales per waiter for a date range: user_id, name, revenue, profit, clients (closed orders), middle_invoice (average check), middle_time (average service time) and worked_time. Amounts are in minor units (divide by 100). Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_client_sales
tools.description: Sales per customer for a date range: client_id, firstname, lastname, sum, revenue, profit, clients (closed orders) and middle_invoice (average check). Amounts are in minor units (divide by 100). Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_spot_sales
tools.description: Sales totals of one location or of all locations for a date range: revenue, profit, clients (closed orders) and middle_invoice (average check). Amounts are in minor units (divide by 100). Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

spot_id.description: Location id from poster_pos_list_spots. Default: all locations.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_payments_report
tools.description: Payments by day for a date range (by month when the range is longer than 65 days): days rows with date, payed_cash_sum, payed_card_sum, payed_bonus_sum, payed_cert_in_sum, payed_cert_out_sum and payed_sum_sum, plus total with the same sums and payed_third_party_sum. Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

spot_id.description: Location id from poster_pos_list_spots. Default: all locations.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_cash_shifts
tools.description: List the register (cash) shifts of a date range: cash_shift_id, spot_id, spot_name, date_start, date_end, amount_start, amount_end, amount_sell_cash, amount_sell_card, amount_debit, amount_credit, amount_collection, user_id_start, user_id_end and comment. Amounts are in minor units (divide by 100). Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

spot_id.description: Location id from poster_pos_list_spots. Default: all locations.

timezone.description: client to return date_start and date_end in the account time zone.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_clients
tools.description: List customers: client_id, firstname, lastname, phone, email, birthday, card_number, client_sex, city, address, comment, discount_per, bonus (loyalty points, minor units), total_payed_sum (minor units), date_activale, client_groups_id and client_groups_name. Without num and offset Poster returns every customer in one answer, so page large bases with num and offset, or search by phone. Read-only.

offset.description: Customers to skip from the start.

phone.description: Find the customer with this phone number in international format, e.g. +380501234567.

birthday.description: Only customers born on this day, as month and day MMDD, e.g. 1123 for 23 November.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_client
tools.description: Read one customer: the fields of poster_pos_list_clients plus the loyalty group settings (loyalty_type, client_groups_discount, birthday_bonus), ewallet, accumulation_products and prize_products of promotions. The answer is a list with one element. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_client_groups
tools.description: List the customer groups: client_groups_id, client_groups_name, client_groups_discount (percent), loyalty_type, birthday_bonus, count_groups_clients and use_ewallet. A group id is needed to create a customer. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_create_client
tools.description: Create a customer in the loyalty base. Returns the new client_id as response. Poster refuses a phone number that another customer already has and answers error 34 when a required property is missing, so pass a name and a group. The points balance and purchase total cannot be set here. Search by phone with poster_pos_list_clients first to avoid duplicates.

phone.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. +380501234567. Unique: two customers cannot share a number.

discount_per.description: Personal discount or points percentage; applies when higher than the group percentage.

tools.name: poster_pos_update_client
tools.description: Change the properties of a customer: name, group, phone, email, birthday, card number, personal discount, address or comment. Only the fields you pass are sent. Returns the client_id as response. The points balance and purchase total cannot be changed here.

phone.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. +380501234567. Unique: two customers cannot share a number.

discount_per.description: Personal discount or points percentage; applies when higher than the group percentage.

tools.name: poster_pos_remove_client
tools.description: Remove a customer from the loyalty base. Their points and purchase history are no longer available on the register. Installed switched off.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_storages
tools.description: List the storages (stock rooms): storage_id, storage_name, storage_adress and delete (1 when removed). Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_stock_leftovers
tools.description: Current stock per ingredient or product: ingredient_id, ingredient_name, ingredient_unit, ingredient_left (total over all storages), storage_ingredient_left (in the chosen storage), limit_value (low stock threshold), storage_ingredient_sum and prime_cost (minor units, divide by 100), ingredients_type and hidden. Read-only.

storage_id.description: Only this storage (poster_pos_list_storages). Default: all storages.

type.description: 1 product, 2 manufactured dish, 3 semi-finished product, 4 ingredient, 5 product modifier. Default: all.

category_id.description: Only ingredients of this ingredient category.

zero_leftovers.description: true to include rows with zero stock.

tools.name: poster_pos_get_stock_movement_report
tools.description: Stock movement report per ingredient for a date range: ingredient_id, ingredient_name, start (opening quantity), income, write_offs, end (closing quantity), cost_start and cost_end. Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

storage_id.description: Only this storage. Default: all storages.

type.description: 1 ingredient, 2 product, 3 product modification, 4 dish, 5 preparation. Default: all.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers: supplier_id, supplier_name, supplier_phone, supplier_adress, supplier_comment, supplier_code, supplier_tin and delete (1 when removed). Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_supplies
tools.description: List the supplies (goods received) of a date range: supply_id, date, storage_id, storage_name, supplier_id, supplier_name, account_id, supply_sum and supply_sum_netto (minor units, divide by 100), supply_comment and delete. Without dates use limit and offset. Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

limit.description: Number of supplies to return. Ignored when dates are given.

offset.description: Supplies to skip from the newest. Ignored when dates are given.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_supply_ingredients
tools.description: List the lines of one supply: ingredient_id, ingredient_name, ingredient_unit, supply_ingredient_num (quantity), supply_ingredient_sum and supply_ingredient_sum_netto (minor units) and tax_id. Read-only.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_wastes
tools.description: List the manual write-offs (wastes) of a date range: waste_id, date, storage_id, user_id, reason_id, reason_name, total_sum and total_sum_netto (minor units, divide by 100). Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

tools.name: poster_pos_list_stock_transfers
tools.description: List the transfers between storages of a date range: moving_id, date, the source and destination storage with their names, user_id, user_name, sum and sum_netto (minor units, divide by 100). Read-only.

date_from.description: First day as YYYYMMDD without separators, e.g. 20261101. Default: one month ago.

date_to.description: Last day as YYYYMMDD, inclusive, e.g. 20261130. Default: today.

tools.name: poster_pos_create_supplier
tools.description: Create a supplier for stock supplies. Returns the new supplier_id as response. Check poster_pos_list_suppliers first to avoid a duplicate.

supplier_comment.description: Comment, e.g. what the supplier delivers.
